richiami.difetto: null Under certain conditions there is a risk that the ignition switch in the vehicles may move out of the “run” position, resulting in a partial loss of electrical power and turning off the engine. This risk may increase if the key ring is carrying added weight (such as more keys or the key fob) or the vehicle experiences rough road conditions or other jarring or impact related events. When the ignition switch is not in the run position, the air bags may not deploy if the vehicle is involved in a crash, increasing the risk of injury or fatality.  Some vehicles may also have a condition in which the ignition key may be removed when the ignition is not in the “Off” position. In such an event, unintended vehicle motion may occur, resulting in a vehicle crash and occupant or pedestrian injuries.

richiami.difetto: The possibility exists that the clutch cable may break with the consequence that the clutch cannot be disengaged.
richiami.rimedio: Recall likely to be affected vehicles and replace the clutch cable with one of improved quality.

richiami.difetto: There is a possibility that the transmission mounting bolts could break.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles check correct torque and if found incorrectinspect bolts and mountings for damage and replace if necessary.

richiami.difetto: A screw in the motorised throttle idle actuator (MTIA) could be faulty. A faulty MTIA could result in a high engine speed.
richiami.rimedio: Examine and replace the motorised throttle idle actuator where found necessary.
richiami.titolo: HIGH ENGINE SPEED IDLE CONDITION MAY OCCUR

richiami.difetto: The fuel feed and return pipes may detach from the fuel rail and result in a petrol leak.
richiami.rimedio: Fit improved feed and return pipe connectors to the fuel rail.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE DETACHMENT OF FUEL FEED AND RETURN PIPES FROM FUEL RAIL
